description: This file implements a SQL store for managing property fields within the Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, counting, and searching property fields.

classes.name: SqlPropertyFieldStore
classes.description: A SQL-based implementation of the PropertyFieldStore interface, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, delete, and search property fields.

methods.name: newPropertyFieldStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlPropertyFieldStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new PropertyField record in the database after validation.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a PropertyField by groupID and id.

methods.name: GetFieldByName
methods.description: Retrieves a PropertyField by groupID, targetID, and name.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple PropertyFields by their IDs, optionally filtered by groupID.

methods.name: CountForGroup
methods.description: Counts PropertyFields within a group, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: CountForTarget
methods.description: Counts PropertyFields for a specific target, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: SearchPropertyFields
methods.description: Searches for PropertyFields based on various search options.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates multiple PropertyFields within a transaction, validating each.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a PropertyField as deleted by setting DeleteAt timestamp.
